paragraphs: Barricade AI sells multimodal agentic AI that analyzes incidents and investigations for law enforcement. The platform combines audio transcription, visual analysis, metadata and CAD integration rather than transcription alone. One platform supports patrol through command staff and integrates with records and evidence systems.

Officers review, edit and approve every output before submission, and reports follow a department's existing templates and requirements. The company says all data is processed and stored exclusively within United States borders, with on-premises deployment available. It also states zero data retention, with no training use and no external access to agency information.

Setup runs through API integration with Axon and other body worn camera providers, and the site puts pilot setup at less than one working day. Barricade AI says its reports meet state and federal law enforcement documentation requirements, including California SB 524.
